items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce - APSB26-73
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, including issues that could lead to arbitrary code execution, security feature bypass, and privilege escalation.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento (PHP object injection)
items.summary: An unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer allows remote code execution by supplying a crafted serialized PHP object in the CacheWarmer cookie.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: A critical flaw in Magento's REST API allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files to any store by using a polyglot (code disguised as image) to bypass validation.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source (APSB26-05)
items.summary: This bulletin addresses multiple critical security vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security controls, gain escalated privileges, execute unauthorized malicious code, and compromise store data.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization vulnerability leading to Full System Takeover
items.summary: An Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could allow attackers to execute code remotely, leading to a full system takeover.

items.title: Improper Access Control vulnerability leading to Data Leak
items.summary: An Improper Access Control vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could allow attackers to bypass security filters and access restricted information, resulting in a data leak.

items.title: Stored XSS vulnerability leading to Admin Hijacking
items.summary: A Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source could allow malicious scripts to escalate user privileges and hijack admin sessions.

items.title: SessionReaper, unauthenticated RCE in Magento & Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This critical vulnerability allows customer account takeover and unauthenticated remote code execution under certain conditions, with mass attacks observed in the wild.

items.title: Critical, pre-authentication XML entity injection issue (CosmicSting)
items.summary: A critical XML entity injection vulnerability allows attackers to exfiltrate sensitive files, such as cryptographic keys, and can be chained with other bugs for remote code execution. Adobe confirmed exploitation in the wild.

items.title: Magento Improper Access Control vulnerability
items.summary: An Improper Access Control vulnerability in Adobe Commerce could lead to privilege escalation, allowing a low-privileged attacker to bypass security measures and modify limited fields.
